purpose: dual-mode (8-class + 5-group activity) front-end route study: F0 baseline vs F1 native-48k vs F2 decimated-24k vs F2b decimated-16k, float-domain numeric comparison infrastructure

determinism.note: no wall-clock timestamps; repeated runs are byte-identical (fixed tables, fixed FIR taps, seeded synthesis, torch single-thread eval)

input_contract.note: every input is normalized to the 48 kHz float domain (physical PCM1808 input) so all four variants consume the identical PCM; fixtures/demo WAVs are mono-mixed and up-sampled 44.1k -> 48k with soxr_hq

quant_stub_input_contract.description: Mel -> int8 quantization contract (REQ-FTR-006): x_q = sat_u8(round_even(z * inv_s_in >> frac_bits) + zp_in)

data_gaps: No Medley-solos-DB validation audio on this machine; the real clips are 8 IRMAS demo slices (one per instrument, 3 s each), not a validation set
No 'female singer' and no 'distorted electric guitar' demo clip exists in InstRec/data/demo/irmas_test (guitar_electric is the closest neighbour, guitar_acoustic is out of class)
The 8-class accuracy effect of F1/F2 therefore cannot be concluded from this run; only the numeric drift of features and logits on synthetic + demo inputs is measured

S1_mel_table_match.note: gen_mel_tables.py drops COO entries with weight < 1e-4, so up to ~1e-4 difference per dropped entry is expected

conclusions: F1 (native 48k, resampler removed) deviates from F0 by mean|dz|=0.250 / max|dz|=2.608 (z units), Pearson r=0.873: the per-bin feature is NOT interchangeable with the F0 feature.
F2 (24k decimated) deviates from F0 by mean|dz|=0.449 / max|dz|=3.095, Pearson r=0.700; both the Mel remap (fmax 22050 -> 12000) and the 0.94 ms hop time-base shift contribute.
F2b (16k) is a pipeline-only control route: mean|dz|=0.844, fmax collapses to 8 kHz so the upper ~21 Mel channels lose nearly all spectral energy; accuracy numbers are reference only.

Feeding the deployed quantized 8-class model with F1/F2/F2b features shifts the logits by up to 1.243 / 3.889 / 10.024 (mean of per-input max, F1/F2/F2b) and flips the top-1 class on 1/6/9 of 14 inputs -> old weights cannot be reused without retraining.

Feeding the float 8-class model with F1/F2/F2b features shifts the logits by up to 1.231 / 3.906 / 10.760 (mean of per-input max, F1/F2/F2b) and flips the top-1 class on 1/6/9 of 14 inputs -> old weights cannot be reused without retraining.
The group5 v3 float model shows activity drift up to 0.635 / 0.999 / 1.000 (F1/F2/F2b max over inputs), same retraining requirement for the 5-group head.

All sanity checks passed (S1 Mel table, S2 features.py parity, S3 quantization parity), so the drift numbers above are measured on a chain that reproduces the production F0 contract (librosa 1.0.0 / torch 2.14.1+cpu).
